body.value: 藩制一覽表第九（喜連川、結城、湯長谷）
藩制一覧表第九（喜連川、結城、湯長谷）

Running header: Table of Domain Institutions, Fascicle 9 (Kitsuregawa, Yūki, Yunagaya). This is provenance printed in the outer margin, not survey data. It names the three domains whose entries fall on this leaf and its facing leaf, and it identifies the fascicle — the ninth of the nine that make up the 1869-70 Dajōkan survey, the one covering domain officials and military establishments.
柱書藩制一覽表第九
四百四十二
四百四十二
Printed book-page number 442, set in the bottom outer margin. It is the page number of the 1928 Nihon Shiseki Kyōkai edition, not a survey figure.
丁付四百四十二
○喜連川藩
喜連川藩（きつれがわはん）
Maru-marker opening the entry for Kitsuregawa Domain (Shimotsuke province). Everything printed to its left, as far as the ○結城藩 marker, is Kitsuregawa's; on this leaf that amounts to a single column.
喜連川藩マル標
審ナラス
審らかならず

'Not ascertained.' This one column is the whole of Kitsuregawa's fascicle-9 return: neither its councillors nor its troops were reported. The domain was the small Kitsuregawa house of Shimotsuke, and the compilers recorded the gap rather than leaving the entry blank. It is an absence note, not a zero.
喜連川藩審ナラス
○結城藩
結城藩（ゆうきはん）

Maru-marker opening the entry for Yūki Domain (Shimōsa province, the Mizuno house). Everything to its left as far as the ○湯長谷藩 marker is Yūki's — the four councillor columns, the eleven-name roster below them, and the two military columns.
結城藩マル標
大參事　一人
大参事　一人

Senior councillor (daisanji): one. Two names are printed in the roster column directly below this heading — Suzuki Shigezumi in the upper slot and Yoshida Tokiyuki in the lower — so the printed figure and the number of men named do not agree, and the leaf gives no wording that resolves the difference. Two small ink marks stand in the gutter to the right of the figure, where the reduced-type 四人 stands beside 少參事, but they cannot be read.
結城藩大參事
〔判讀不能〕
〔判読不能〕

Two small ink marks in the gutter to the right of the 大參事 figure, in the position the reduced-type 四人 occupies beside 少參事. They are as dark as the printed type (minimum grey 19, against 22-23 for the type on this leaf), so they are not the much lighter facing-page bleed-through, and a connected-component sweep of the whole text block finds no other ink anywhere outside a text column. They are recorded here rather than dropped. No reading can be given: the upper mark is a 30-by-18-pixel wedge and the lower a 15-by-19-pixel blob, neither of them glyph-shaped under magnification, and together they are 29 pixels wide against the 44-to-48 pixels a reduced-type glyph measures on this leaf.
結城藩大參事傍記
權大參事　二人　當時一人
権大参事　二人　当時一人

Provisional senior councillor (gon-daisanji): two, of whom one was serving at the time of the survey. The words 當時一人 are set in reduced type and aligned to the right side of the column, below the full-size 二人. Two names are printed in the roster column below — Mitsuoka Tomotsune and Suzuki Shigeyoshi — matching the figure of two.
結城藩權大參事
四人
四人

Four persons, set in reduced type in the gutter to the right of the 少參事 column, which is where vertical Japanese puts a gloss on the column beside it. Four junior councillors are named in the two columns below the 少參事 heading, so this figure and the roster agree. The leaf does not say how it relates to the full-size 一人 printed under the heading itself.
結城藩少參事定員四人
少參事　一人
少参事　一人

Junior councillor (shōsanji): one. Four junior councillors are named in the two columns below — Inaba Michikiyo, Mizuno Katsutomo, Nakayama Masakuni and Miyata Hidekata — and a reduced-type 四人 stands in the gutter to the right of this figure. The leaf therefore carries two different numbers for this office and does not label either of them; the one office on the leaf that does distinguish the two, 權大參事, writes it out as 二人　當時一人.
結城藩少參事
權少參事
権少参事

Provisional junior councillor (gon-shōsanji). No figure is printed under this heading — the column ends with the fourth glyph and the space below it is blank — so the leaf gives no number for this office. Three men are named in the two columns below: Hirai Yoshiyasu, Yoshikawa Yoshinao and Sekine Norio.
結城藩權少參事
步兵一小隊　但六十人
歩兵一小隊　但し六十人

Infantry: one company, of sixty men. The qualifier 但六十人 ('being sixty men') is set in reduced type below the main line and gives the company's strength. This column stands to the right of the ○湯長谷藩 marker, but in fascicle 9 a domain's military prints after its officials, so it belongs to Yūki, not to Yunagaya. Sixty men is the whole of Yūki's standing force.
結城藩步兵一小隊
小銃　六十挺
小銃　六十挺

Small arms: sixty rifles. One rifle for each of the sixty infantrymen in the company recorded in the column to the right, so the company was fully armed. Like that column, this one lies to the right of the ○湯長谷藩 marker and is still Yūki's.
結城藩小銃
○湯長谷藩
湯長谷藩（ゆながやはん）

Maru-marker opening the entry for Yunagaya Domain (Iwaki, Mutsu province, the Naitō house). Only one column of its entry is printed on this leaf, the vacant senior councillorship immediately to the left.
湯長谷藩マル標
大參事　欠員
大参事　欠員

Senior councillor (daisanji): vacant. 欠員 records a post on the establishment with nobody in it, which is a different statement from a post that does not exist; no name is printed in the roster registers below this column.
湯長谷藩大參事欠員
鈴木重純
鈴木重純（すずき しげずみ）
Suzuki Shigezumi (reading conjectural), senior councillor. First name in the roster's middle register, standing in the column headed 大參事.
結城藩大參事鈴木重純
光岡朝恒
光岡朝恒（みつおか ともつね）
Mitsuoka Tomotsune (reading conjectural), provisional senior councillor. Middle register, in the column headed 權大參事.
結城藩權大參事光岡朝恒
稻葉通精
稲葉通精（いなば みちきよ）
Inaba Michikiyo (reading conjectural), junior councillor. Middle register, in the column headed 少參事, and the first of the four junior councillors named on this leaf.
結城藩少參事稻葉通精
中山昌邦
中山昌邦（なかやま まさくに）

Nakayama Masakuni (reading conjectural), junior councillor. Middle register. This column carries no office heading above it: it continues the junior councillors after the column under the 少參事 heading is full.
結城藩少參事中山昌邦
平井良休
平井良休（ひらい よしやす）
Hirai Yoshiyasu (reading conjectural), provisional junior councillor. Middle register, in the column headed 權少參事.
結城藩權少參事平井良休
關根矩尾
関根矩尾（せきね のりお）

Sekine Norio (reading conjectural), provisional junior councillor. Leftmost column of the roster's middle register, and the only one with no name beneath it in the lower register — the eleventh and last officeholder Yūki reported.
結城藩權少參事關根矩尾
吉田時之
吉田時之（よしだ ときゆき）

Yoshida Tokiyuki (reading conjectural), senior councillor. Lower register, directly beneath Suzuki Shigezumi in the column headed 大參事. His presence puts two names under a heading whose printed figure is 一人; the 少參事 column shows the same kind of gap, four names under a printed 一人, so this is not the only place on the leaf where roster and figure differ.
結城藩大參事吉田時之
鈴木重義
鈴木重義（すずき しげよし）
Suzuki Shigeyoshi (reading conjectural), provisional senior councillor. Lower register, beneath Mitsuoka Tomotsune; the two of them make up the two men recorded as 權大參事二人.
結城藩權大參事鈴木重義
水野勝與
水野勝与（みずの かつとも）

Mizuno Katsutomo (reading conjectural), junior councillor. Lower register, beneath Inaba Michikiyo. Mizuno was the daimyo house of Yūki, so the surname is the ruling family's, though the leaf says nothing about how this man stood to the daimyo.
結城藩少參事水野勝與
宮田秀堅
宮田秀堅（みやた ひでかた）
Miyata Hidekata (reading conjectural), junior councillor. Lower register, beneath Nakayama Masakuni; the fourth and last of the junior councillors.
結城藩少參事宮田秀堅
吉川好直
吉川好直（よしかわ よしなお）
Yoshikawa Yoshinao (reading conjectural), provisional junior councillor. Lower register, beneath Hirai Yoshiyasu.
結城藩權少參事吉川好直
